title: ID0432040-DC/Si-D/BE-[MULTIPLE] Screensaver Deactivated
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
CCV on the 170001834 works. So the two screensavers you can
find attached may be deactivated. The screensaver with our
company data must remain active at all times.
CCV on the 170001836 & 170001838 does not work. Here the
screensavers, see attachment, must be activated. Together with the
screensaver with our company data.
Solution:
Screensaver Activated.
